pages.title: Choose Two Ends
pages.text: Right-click a block to set the start, then right-click the destination to place the section.$(br2)For chests and other inventories, hold sneak and click the exact horizontal face you want. That face is highlighted while you aim. The adjacent space must be clear.

pages.title: Choose a Route
pages.text: Press $(thing)Tab$() during the preview to cycle between $(thing)Straight$() and $(thing)Spline$(). Your last choice is remembered by the client.$(br2)Straight follows straight runs with rounded right-angle turns. Spline follows a flowing curve. Both support climbs and descents.

pages.title: Stack and Extend
pages.text: Attaching directly to a container face lets you place vertically stacked connections without a support block below each start.$(br2)Extend a line through a belt's open input or output. Another belt's side cannot receive items.$(br2)Right-click air during the preview to cancel.
